positioning.one_liner: See what moved across prediction markets, perpetuals and Solana token markets. Follow the source, test your thesis, keep the research.

icps.buyer: Prediction-market participants, event-market researchers and probability analysts
icps.pain: Odds screens without research provenance and event activity context
icps.job: Understand what event market changed and what source supports it
icps.first_value: Real Polymarket event with reported activity, liquidity and timing
icps.retention: Repeat research, saved event context/alerts only once shipped

icps.buyer: Active perp-market researchers, risk analysts and Hyperliquid ecosystem participants
icps.pain: Funding/OI context and methodology are scattered or poorly labeled
icps.job: Explain perp positioning changes with source provenance
icps.first_value: Hyperliquid source raw funding, reported volume, approximate USD open interest
icps.retention: Compare market observations over time when implemented

icps.buyer: Solana token researchers and meme-market participants investigating mints and pools
icps.venue: Existing Solana Token Radar; pump.fun/Axiom/GMGN etc research only
icps.pain: Launch hype obscures pool liquidity and source integrity
icps.job: Investigate source-reported token pools, liquidity and changes
icps.first_value: Actual Solana mint lookup with timestamped source observations
icps.retention: Repeat token research and saved lists where supported

icps.buyer: Market-data builders and small research teams
icps.job: Inspect reproducible public market data and methodology
icps.revenue: API/team plans only after validated demand and real delivery

north_star.label: Weekly qualified returning researchers
north_star.definition: Unique eligible real human users completing a source-backed research action on two different UTC days in one rolling 7-day window
north_star.denominator: eligible unique researchers in the seven-day cohort

kpis.formula: Unique real visitors with first actual source-backed research action; never count a page view as research
Eligible signups with qualifying real research within 24h / eligible real signups
Matured day-zero researchers with another qualified action on day 1-7 / matured day-zero researchers
Actual qualified research sessions attributed to source/community campaign / observed eligible arrivals
Distinct real user problem reports or feedback tied to a market research action with verifiable provenance
Percentage of source-observed API responses within venue-specific freshness limits; unavailable is explicit
Verified matured trial users with signed paid entitlements / eligible matured trials
Real processor-settled CAD receipts minus refunds, processing, marginal data/provider/host costs
Genuinely published helpful external research links, verified from native platform

experiments.reassess: Two measured seven-day cohorts; iterate on most-qualified channel and biggest activation obstacle
experiments.budget_priority: Actual usable research and distribution first; no new scheduler

freshness.before_publish: Verify each venue/source capability claim against active product and primary provider docs
freshness.stale_policy: Mark STALE or UNKNOWN, repair source and workpacket, keep other independent reversible tasks progressing
freshness.financial_claims: Source-reported plans and selected trial tier never count as collected cash

agent_contract.dispatcher: Existing Sina Founder OS / Company OS / Governor / Agent Fabric
agent_contract.unsupported_claims: Draft missions, generated prompts, user counts, joins and cash have no verified status without native evidence
